t: Microchip's long-running 8-bit microcontroller family for embedded C projects.
steps: Buy a PIC18F57Q43 Curiosity Nano board from DigiKey for about 11 dollars.
Download and install the free MPLAB X IDE and the XC8 compiler from Microchip.
Plug the board in with a micro USB cable.
Create a new project and pick the PIC18F57Q43 as the device.
Use the MPLAB Code Configurator to set the clock and configuration bits.
Write a blink program for the onboard LED and press run.
Browse the Microchip example repos on GitHub for your next project.
meta: Open Board. From $10.61. A few stores.
